==Skin Trivia==
*Originally, the '''Shotgunner''' when it was called '''Enforcer''' was meant to have a SWAT shield at Level 5. This, however, was not added.
*The original Level 3-5 {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} skin used the [[w:c:r2da:Pumpkin Vest|Pumpkin Vest]] from ''R2DA''.
*The current {{Color|Mission|Slayer}} skin is based on [[w:c:doom:Doom Guy (Classic Games)|Doom Guy]] from ''DOOM''.
**The original {{Color|Mission|Slayer}} skin was heavily based on [[w:c:doom:Doom Slayer|Doom Slayer]] from ''DOOM'' .
**The Level 5 double barrel shotgun used by the {{Color|Mission|Slayer}} skin during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] was likely based on the [[w:c:doom:Super Shotgun|Super Shotgun]] from ''DOOM''.
*The {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin is based on the original design of the Default '''Shotgunner'''.
*The [[Mega Slow]] and [[Slow Boss]] could be seen behind '''Shotgunner''' on the second Level 5 upgrade icon.
*The {{Color|Showtime|Trumpeteer}} skin was a submission conceptualized and modeled by [https://twitter.com/SoupedGun SoupedGun].
**The skin was inspired by jazz artists from the 1940s and 1950s, specifically from the New Orleans area.
**Originally, the skin was going to have an Elvis-styled pompadour and custom animations, where it would sit on a stool and blow the trumpet to deal damage.
*The {{Color|Scuba|Scuba Ops}} skin was made by Linx.<ref>https://x.com/LinxtheDev/status/2073078053920489822</ref>

===Roblox Catalog===
*The original Level 0-3 Default hat was a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1081392|Police Sergeants Cap}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The original Level 2 Default badge was the {{RLinkC|79446433|Salute}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*Originally, there was a glitch where the {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} would have a black torso between Level 0-3, instead of an orange torso.
**The shield that would be used was the {{RLinkC|82357079|Riot Shield and Billy Club Set}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 2-4 {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} wears the {{RLinkC|4085923851|Badass Shades for Badass Individuals}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The Level 5 {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} wears the {{RLinkC|4794152748|Red Badass Shades for Badass Individuals}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 4-5 {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} cap is the {{RLinkC|14462497|Biker Cap}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 2-4 {{Color|Halloween|Hallow Punk}} headphones are the {{RLinkC|96079043|Extreme Headphones}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The second versions of the Level 2-4 Default, {{Color|Premium|Classic}} and {{Color|Unobtainable|Spooky}} skins wore the {{RLinkC|30331986|Midnight Shades}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The Level 5 shades were a re-textured version of it.
*The original Level 4-5 {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin used a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|323418594|Daring Blonde Beard}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 4-5 {{Color|Mission|Slayer}} skin used a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|4776495405|The Bug Stomper}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
